violations.description: Untrusted issue title interpolated directly into shell script
violations.recommendation: Pass untrusted input via environment variables instead of direct expression interpolation in shell commands.

violations.description: Workflow triggered by issue comment uses substring check on github.actor for authorization gate
violations.recommendation: Use exact equality or secure authorization checks instead of substring matching on github.actor.

violations.description: Verbose curl logging transmits authorization bearer token to local test server
violations.recommendation: Remove curl verbose flag (-v) or avoid logging authorization headers.
